tooltip.powergrid.guide_book.desc_1: §7Comprehensive electrical engineering manual for modern power grids.§r
tooltip.powergrid.guide_book.desc_2: §6Right-click to open Table of Contents & Blueprints.§r
tooltip.powergrid.treated_wood_pole.desc: §eRight-click with pole in hand to extend the column upwards.§r
tooltip.powergrid.steel_truss_pole.desc_: §eRight-click with pole in hand to extend the tower upwards.§r
tooltip.powergrid.pole_crossarm.desc_1: §7Horizontal structural crossarm for power poles and towers.§r
tooltip.powergrid.pole_crossarm.desc_2: §bMounts wire connectors, relays, and pole street lights.§r
tooltip.powergrid.connector.mode_tip: §bRight-click with Engineer's Hammer to cycle: AUTO / INPUT / OUTPUT.§r
tooltip.powergrid.lv_wire_connector.desc: §7Connects Low Voltage (LV) overhead wires to machinery or grid blocks.§r
tooltip.powergrid.mv_wire_connector.desc: §7Connects Medium Voltage (MV) overhead wires to machinery or grid blocks.§r
tooltip.powergrid.hv_wire_connector.desc: §7Connects High Voltage (HV) overhead wires to heavy machinery or transformers.§r
tooltip.powergrid.lv_wire_relay.desc: §7Through-junction relay for Low Voltage (LV) wire lines without buffering.§r
tooltip.powergrid.mv_wire_relay.desc: §7Through-junction relay for Medium Voltage (MV) wire lines without buffering.§r
tooltip.powergrid.hv_wire_relay.desc: §7Through-junction relay for High Voltage (HV) wire lines without buffering.§r
tooltip.powergrid.transformer.desc_2: §6Bridges voltage tiers and converts energy between connected grids.§r
tooltip.powergrid.breaker_switch.desc_2: §6Right-click or apply redstone to open/close the circuit.§r
tooltip.powergrid.breaker_switch.desc_3: §8Supports LV, MV, and HV wire lines (Max 2 connections).§r
tooltip.powergrid.heavy_accumulator.desc: §eAutomatically outputs energy to adjacent power consumers and cables.§r
tooltip.powergrid.solar_panel.desc_1: §7Photovoltaic solar generator. Generates clean renewable energy in daylight.§r
tooltip.powergrid.solar_panel.desc_3: §8Automatically balances energy across connected panel arrays.§r
tooltip.powergrid.gold_solar_panel.desc_: §8Automatically balances energy across connected panel arrays.§r
tooltip.powergrid.diamond_solar_panel.de: §8Automatically balances energy across connected panel arrays.§r
tooltip.powergrid.tripod_work_light.desc: §7Dual halogen job-site work light on safety-yellow telescoping tripod stand.§r
§eRight-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15). Accepts redstone control.§r
tooltip.powergrid.ceiling_shop_light.des: §7Commercial dual-tube fluorescent fixture mounted flush to ceilings.§r
§eRight-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15). Accepts redstone control.§r
tooltip.powergrid.wall_floodlight.desc_1: §7Architectural outdoor security floodlight with dual angled heads.§r
tooltip.powergrid.wall_floodlight.desc_2: §eRight-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15). Accepts redstone control.§r
tooltip.powergrid.carriage_lantern.desc_: §7Traditional coach and carriage exterior wall lantern with glowing filament.§r
§eRight-click to toggle on/off (Light Level 15). Accepts redstone control.§r
tooltip.powergrid.hammer.desc_3: §7Right-click Power Cable: Toggle side connection on/off.§r
tooltip.powergrid.voltmeter.desc: §7Right-click on connectors, poles, or batteries to inspect voltage, throughput, and grid topology.§r
tooltip.powergrid.cutters.desc: §7Right-click a connector or relay to cleanly sever all attached wire connections.§r
tooltip.powergrid.cutters.desc_2: §8Instantly snips and retrieves indoor AWG power cables.§r
tooltip.powergrid.treated_wood.desc: §7Creosote-treated durable lumber for utility poles and crossarms.§r
tooltip.powergrid.copper_wire.desc: §7Conductive copper wire for Low Voltage (LV) distribution.§r
tooltip.powergrid.electrum_wire.desc: §7High-conductivity gold-silver alloy wire for Medium Voltage (MV) transmission.§r
tooltip.powergrid.steel_strand.desc: §7High-tensile steel core for High Voltage (HV) long-distance cables.§r
tooltip.powergrid.cable_tip: §8Right-click face with Engineer's Hammer to toggle side connections.§r
tooltip.powergrid.street_light.desc: §7North American municipal street light. Default standby illumination (Level 7) when unpowered; boosts to brilliant golden sodium radiance (Level 15) when powered at base with 5 FE/t. Sneak-Right-Click with Engineer's Hammer toggles Dusk-to-Dawn photocell sensor.§r
tooltip.powergrid.pole_street_light.desc: §7Utility pole attachment street light. Powered exclusively by overhead pole wires via its built-in wire terminal insulator. Standby glow (Level 7) when unpowered; boosts to brilliant golden sodium radiance (Level 15) when energized with 5 FE/t. Sneak-Right-Click with Engineer's Hammer toggles Dusk-to-Dawn photocell sensor.§r
tooltip.powergrid.wooden_water_wheel.des: §7Kinetic hydroelectric generator (3x3x1). Generates 10 FE/t per vertical height level of water drop when placed in flowing water. Center axle hub pushes energy out to batteries, transformers, and cables.§r
tooltip.powergrid.wooden_water_wheel.sta: §8Stack multiple water wheels along the axle shaft to pool and transfer energy directly through the stack to transformers or energy storage!§r
tooltip.powergrid.windmill_rotor.desc: §7Aerodynamic kinetic wind generator (3x3x1). Generates clean renewable energy when elevated in open air.§r
tooltip.powergrid.windmill_rotor.clearan: §eRequires at least 3 air blocks of ground clearance beneath the rotor to spin. Power increases with height above ground!§r
tooltip.powergrid.windmill_rotor.stack: §8Stack rotors along their axle line to pool and transfer energy directly into transformers, accumulators, or cables!§r
